name: 5E Resources Holdings Berhad
overview: 5E Resources 于2026年4月在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市，首次公开募股（IPO）发行3.045亿股新股。公司业务线未发生明显变化，公告主要为上市相关程序、季度业绩及派息。
overview_en: 5E Resources listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in April 2026 through an initial public offering (IPO) of 304.5 million new shares. There were no significant changes to the company's business lines; announcements mainly related to listing procedures, quarterly results, and dividend payments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年4月完成IPO并在ACE市场上市，发行3.045亿股新股。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in April 2026, issuing 304.5 million new shares.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF 5E RESOURCES HOLDINGS BERHAD ("5E RESOURCES" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MAR
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股（IPO），公开发行3.045亿股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) of 304,500,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
